items.title: Hilda Taylor Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: Do you remember what that was, Darryl?

ctx.x: And he'd go out to the Jump Hotel on that side of the bank.
Uh huh. Jitney dancing. Do you remember what that was, Darryl?

I forgot, I forgot the name of the place, but I had my band in there once. In fact, it was my band and it was James Davis's job and he took my band in there. And after he got on his feet, you know, I'm out. You know how that goes.
